name: swift-shell-bundled
description: Curated offline packages bundled with SwiftShell. No network access is ever used.

packages.name: hello
packages.description: A friendly greeting and an argument echo.
packages.author: SwiftShell contributors

files.main.shs:
# hello - a tiny starter package
let greeting = "Hello from the SwiftShell registry!"
echo greeting
echo "Arguments: ${args()}"

packages.name: sysinfo
packages.description: Print platform, architecture, Node and working directory details.
packages.author: SwiftShell contributors

files.main.shs:
# sysinfo - quick system report
echo "SwiftShell ${version()}"
echo "platform:     ${$(uname -s)}"
echo "architecture: ${$(uname -m)}"
echo "node:         ${$(node --version)}"
echo "cwd:          ${pwd()}"

packages.name: swiftfetch
packages.description: A polished neofetch-style readout of the host, shell, CPU, memory, disk, network and SwiftShell itself.
packages.author: SwiftShell contributors

files.main.shs:
# swiftfetch - a neofetch-style system report
swiftfetch
